subject: general
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **stacked.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Stacked** means to arrange things in an ordered pile.

 
 
• **Example -** *She opened it and **stacked** the keys in it.*
 
 
 
• ​Here, in the given paragraph **'stacked'** is used to explain **"...the papers she had put together at the desk."**
 
• So, it is clear that the most appropriate word is **'stacked'**.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

 

**Correct Paragraph:** *Salander sat for a while (1) **holding**__ the telephone after Armansky hung up. She went to her work corner in the living room (2) __**and**__ looked at the notes she had pinned up on the wall and the papers she had **(3)** __**stacked**__ on the desk. What she had managed to collect was mostly press cuttings and articles (4) ______ from the Internet. She took the papers and dropped (5) ______ in a desk drawer.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Tacked** means to fasten or attach with a tack. 
 
• **Slacked** means to work more slowly and with less effort than usual.
 
• **Mounded** means a small hill or pile of dirt or stones.
